name: Google Business Profile
what_to_do: Claim and fully complete the profile, add photos, services, hours, posts weekly.
notes: Verification by postcard/video/phone can take days. Top priority for local businesses.

name: Bing Places for Business
what_to_do: Import from Google Business Profile in a few clicks.
notes: Also feeds data to other search engines and assistants.

name: Apple Business Connect
what_to_do: Claim your place so it shows correctly in Apple Maps.

name: Facebook Page
what_to_do: Create a page, add NAP details, post regularly, join local groups.
notes: Group self-promotion rules vary; read each group's rules.

name: LinkedIn Company Page
what_to_do: Create the page, publish articles, share in relevant groups.

name: Instagram Business
what_to_do: Business account, Reels and local hashtags.

name: YouTube Channel
what_to_do: Publish how-to videos and local explainers with keyword-rich descriptions.

name: Pinterest Business
what_to_do: Create boards and pins linking to useful pages.
notes: Strong for visual and DIY niches.

name: Medium
what_to_do: Republish or adapt blog posts with a canonical link.
notes: Use canonical import to avoid duplicate content.

name: LinkedIn Articles
what_to_do: Publish expertise articles under the founder's profile.
notes: Personal profiles get more reach than pages.

name: Substack
what_to_do: Start a newsletter to own your audience.

name: Quora
what_to_do: Answer niche questions with genuine value; link only when relevant.

name: Reddit
what_to_do: Find niche and city subreddits, contribute for 2+ weeks before sharing links.
notes: Each subreddit has its own self-promo rules; accounts get banned for spam.

name: Crunchbase
what_to_do: Create an organisation profile.

name: Product Hunt
what_to_do: Launch software or digital products.
notes: Prepare assets and a launch-day community.

name: Trustpilot
what_to_do: Claim the profile and invite genuine customer reviews.
notes: Paid tiers add invitations and widgets.

name: G2
what_to_do: List software products and request reviews.

name: Clutch
what_to_do: List agency or B2B service profile with verified client reviews.

name: Yelp for Business
what_to_do: Claim the listing if your market uses Yelp.
notes: Limited usage in some countries; ads are paid.

name: HARO / Connectively alternatives (Qwoted, Featured)
what_to_do: Respond to journalist queries in your expertise area.
notes: Free tiers are limited; availability of services changes, verify before relying.

name: Google Ads
est_cost: Pay per click; set a daily budget
what_to_do: Start with a small local search campaign on high-intent keywords.
notes: Needs conversion tracking to judge ROI.

name: Meta Ads
what_to_do: Local awareness or lead-form campaigns.

name: LinkedIn Ads
est_cost: Typically the most expensive per click
what_to_do: B2B targeting by job title and industry.

name: Justdial
what_to_do: Create the free listing; evaluate paid ranking only after tracking leads.
notes: Expect sales calls for paid plans.

name: Sulekha
what_to_do: List services and respond to leads.

name: IndiaMART
what_to_do: List products for B2B buyers.
notes: Best for manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers.

name: TradeIndia
what_to_do: B2B listing for products and exporters.

name: Urban Company (service providers)
what_to_do: Apply as a professional if you offer home or beauty services.

name: Grotal
what_to_do: Free local listing.

name: Indian Chambers of Commerce (FICCI / CII / local chamber)
what_to_do: Check membership for credibility, events and networking in your city.
notes: Membership fees vary by chamber; look for your district chamber too.

name: Nextdoor
what_to_do: Create a business page for neighbourhood recommendations.

name: Better Business Bureau
what_to_do: Consider accreditation if trust matters in your niche.

name: Yell
what_to_do: Create a free listing.
